# G04-PF005 public Text/Char/Bytes fixtures

Six positive programs exercise the public vertical pipeline. Thirteen negative programs freeze Char, alias, receiver, arity, deferred-API and unknown textual API diagnostics.

Rework v4 also reuses `examples/soma.no` as the public receiver-first ownership proof: declared user functions must remain owned by the ordinary resolver rather than the bounded G04 Text/Char/Bytes API recognizer.
